name: HMC Transformation Stages
source: Human Maximus Codex - Meaning PDF, HMC batch-1 distillation 2026-10-06

stages.exit_condition: the person has named what was running them
stages.intent: see the autopilot - you are more than the identity the world handed you

stages.exit_condition: the leaks are named and closing
stages.intent: clear clutter - old beliefs, energy leaks, noise that isn't theirs
discipline, routines, clarity - the daily architecture

stages.exit_condition: the person is creating for others, not only themselves
stages.intent: purpose, creativity, leadership, service - building outward
become a source of strength for others
